nextGame.note: Sunday road game at Chicago. Noon our time, on Fox 8. Chicago has won seven games and lost two. The Saints have won three and lost six, and Carolina leads the division with four wins and five losses.

news.headline: Asim Richards will miss a few weeks with a knee injury
news.summary: The right tackle hurt his knee against Carolina on Sunday and will be out a few weeks, Kellen Moore said Monday. Rookie Mason Murphy took his place, and the Saints are already missing their center and their other starting tackle.

news.headline: Kellen Moore says he will call plays more aggressively
news.summary: The Saints did not score in the first half and lost 20-17, and on Monday the head coach said the play calling has to change. He said he needs to be more aggressive and find ways to get the ball down the field.

news.headline: Pete Werner hurt his hamstring against Carolina
news.summary: The Saints linebacker left in the first half and did not come back. Coach Kellen Moore said it is his left hamstring and the team is still checking on him.

nextGame.note: Saturday morning home game in Gainesville. Eleven o'clock our time, on the SEC Network. It is Florida's last home game of the year. Florida has won six games and lost four and is already going to a bowl game. Vanderbilt has won four games and lost six.

news.headline: Florida makes the playoff rankings for the first time
news.summary: The playoff committee ranked Florida 24th on Tuesday. It is the first time the Gators have been on that list this season, and it comes after their win at Kentucky.

news.headline: Aaron Philo wins two awards for his game at Kentucky
news.summary: The Southeastern Conference named Philo its best offensive player of the week, and the Davey O'Brien award put him on its list of the eight best quarterbacks in the country. He threw for 119 yards and ran for 102 at Kentucky, the first Florida quarterback to run for a hundred yards in a game since 2022.

news.headline: Aaron Philo will keep starting for Florida
news.summary: Coach Jon Sumrall said Aaron Philo starts Saturday against Vanderbilt. He said Philo will probably start the rest of the season if he keeps playing the way he did at Kentucky.

nextGame.note: Saturday afternoon road game in Knoxville, Tennessee. Half past two our time. LSU has won six games and lost four. Tennessee has won eight games and lost two.

news.headline: Lane Kiffin goes back to Tennessee, where he once coached
news.summary: LSU plays at Tennessee on Saturday. Kiffin was the head coach there for one season in 2009 before he left for another job, and he said Monday that going back has not been on his mind.

news.headline: Kiffin is not looking at the backup quarterbacks
news.summary: Lane Kiffin was asked if the last two games are a chance to try the backup quarterbacks. He said he does not think that way, and that Sam Leavitt made some really poor decisions in the loss to Texas.

news.headline: Lane Kiffin says LSU has a ways to go
news.summary: After Saturday's loss, LSU's first-year coach said it was fair to ask questions about a team with six wins and four losses, and that the Tigers are not a dominant team yet. The loss all but ends their chance at the national playoff.

news.headline: Tulane's last road game is set for 2:30 Saturday
news.summary: Tulane plays at South Florida on Saturday, November 28, at half past two in the afternoon. The game is on ESPN+, which comes with YouTube TV at no extra charge.

news.headline: Tulane's Saturday kickoff is set for 11 in the morning
news.summary: Tulane plays North Texas at Yulman Stadium at 11 o'clock Saturday morning, on ESPNU. A win sends the Green Wave to a bowl game.

news.headline: Tulane wins at Rice 20-17 after a bus ride
news.summary: Friday's nationwide halt on flights meant Tulane rode a bus to Houston and got in around two in the morning. Bredell Richardson caught a 24-yard pass from Trace Johnson in the fourth quarter for the winning points, and the Green Wave are now five wins and five losses.

news.headline: Brother Martin's playoff game moves to Friday at Tad Gormley
news.summary: Brother Martin plays Bonnabel in the second round on Friday at 3:30 in the afternoon at Tad Gormley Stadium in City Park. Brother Martin is the higher seed, so it is the home team and nobody has to leave New Orleans.

news.headline: Brother Martin gets the 8th seed and a first-round bye
news.summary: The state playoff brackets came out Sunday. Brother Martin does not have to play in the first round and will wait for the winner of Bonnabel and Peabody.

news.headline: Easton Royal scores four touchdowns in Brother Martin win
news.summary: Royal ran for 165 yards and three touchdowns and returned a kickoff 75 yards for another in the 27-14 win over Holy Cross. Brother Martin finished the regular season with seven wins and three losses.
